title: Second-Domain Lifecycle Replication, Four-Coordinate Context-Basis Closure, Cross-Domain Deletion Completeness, Pairwise & Higher-Order Quotient Exhaustion, Primitive Independence Reconstitution, Minimal-Sufficiency Transport, Literature-Novelty Boundary Consolidation & the Court of Whether (X,G,E) Contains a Reproducible Minimal Context Basis
primary_scientific_question: Does LIFECYCLE_PHASE replicate as an exact discriminator in a genuinely second software domain, and if so does the four-coordinate X basis survive exhaustive deletion and quotient attacks without post-hoc coordinate expansion?

lifecycle_exactness_rule.intervention: Vary only lifecycle phase under the same operational object, authority, compatibility/coexistence obligations, geometry, and material evidence envelope.
lifecycle_exactness_rule.second_domain: Must not reuse the P12 GatherPress event-lifecycle mechanism as the only authority.

four_coordinate_basis_court.deletion: Delete each coordinate independently; every retained coordinate must destroy at least one exact replicated action distinction.
four_coordinate_basis_court.pairwise_quotients: Test all six pairwise merges among the four coordinates. A merge survives only if no exact witness requires the two coordinates separately.
four_coordinate_basis_court.higher_order_quotients: Test all four three-into-one collapse families and the full four-into-one collapse as semantic quotients, not merely label concatenation.
four_coordinate_basis_court.recoverability: A retained primitive must be operationally recoverable without observing the target action.
four_coordinate_basis_court.transport: Every coordinate in a claimed reproducible minimal basis requires exact support in at least two genuinely distinct software domains.
four_coordinate_basis_court.minimality: Minimal-basis authority requires transport + deletion necessity + pairwise quotient failure + no justified finer prospective split.

independence_stress.cross_coordinate: Seek interventions where exactly one coordinate changes while the remaining three and G,E are materially fixed.
independence_stress.dependency_graph: Allow directional dependencies, but reject any claim that one coordinate is primitive if it is deterministically derivable from the others across all exact worlds.
independence_stress.negative_controls: Each promotion family must preserve at least one nearby non-discriminating or confound-breaking control when available.

literature_and_data.rule: Literature or custody findings cannot alter P16 scientific thresholds after preseal.

r2_gate: LAW-R2 remains unauthorized unless fresh normalized same-(X,G,E) conflicting action survives all permitted basis reconstruction and hosted replay.
